cypher: MATCH (s:Substation) WHERE NOT EXISTS { (:Forecast)-[:FORECAST_FOR]->(s) } RETURN s.id AS id, s.name AS name LIMIT 100

MATCH (r:Region)<-[:LOCATED_IN]-(:Substation)<-[:CONNECTED_TO]-(:Consumer)-[:HAS_METER]->(m:Meter) WITH r, count(DISTINCT m) AS total, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.status = 'несправний' THEN m END) AS faulty RETURN r.name AS region, total, faulty, toFloat(faulty) / total AS faultyShare ORDER BY faultyShare DESC LIMIT 100

MATCH (m:Measurement) WHERE m.timestamp >= localdatetime('2026-09-28T00:00:00') AND m.timestamp < localdatetime('2026-09-29T00:00:00') RETURN m.id AS id, m.name AS name, m.timestamp AS timestamp, m.consumptionValue AS consumptionValue, m.voltage AS voltage ORDER BY m.timestamp LIMIT 100

MATCH (d:Dispatcher)-[:MANAGES]->(:Substation)-[:FEEDS*0..]->(:Substation)<-[:CONNECTED_TO]-(c:Consumer) WITH DISTINCT d, c RETURN d.id AS dispatcherId, d.name AS dispatcher, count(c) AS affectedConsumers, sum(coalesce(c.contractLimit, 0.0)) AS totalContractLimit ORDER BY totalContractLimit DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (d:Dispatcher)-[:MANAGES]->(:Substation)<-[:CONNECTED_TO]-(c:Consumer) RETURN d.id AS dispatcherId, d.name AS dispatcher, count(DISTINCT c) AS consumerCount ORDER BY consumerCount DESC LIMIT 1
